comparison: C binary32 stages versus frozen comparison_raw13 Python binary64 arrays
criterion: abs(C-Python) <= atol + rtol*abs(Python), every element; complex FFT uses error magnitude

rationale.input_float: PCM16 division by power-of-two 32768 is exact in binary32.
rationale.preemphasis_frames_windowed: Normalized sample amplitudes, coefficient conversion and two separately rounded float operations; absolute term covers cancellation and relative term covers headroom up to 1.95.
rationale.fft: Unnormalized 512-point transform has a larger scale and nine butterfly stages; account for accumulated binary32 rounding with 2e-5 absolute and relative budgets. Small spectral values also undergo stricter downstream log/MFCC tests.
rationale.power_mel_energy: Squared normalized amplitude units: 1e-8 absolute floor plus 5e-5 relative budget for squares and sequential positive sums. Passing near-zero energy under this bound alone does not prove log accuracy.
rationale.log_mel: Natural-log dimensionless units; initial 1e-3 absolute +1e-5 relative budget. Expose weak-energy sensitivity rather than modifying the common 1e-12 floor.
rationale.dct_mfcc: User/MFCC_SPEC initial target 1e-3 +1e-5*abs(Python). No relaxation based on evaluation results.

policy: Develop synthetic17+development1 first. Freeze source, coefficients, compiler/options, tolerance, reference identity before evaluation20. Preserve unsuccessful development runs.
